items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix; no deal completed until after Sunday games.
items.why: Team comfortable with offer; tenure in AZ over.
items.implication: Removes MHJ from Week 5 projections entirely; long-term destination TBD (HOU possible for Stroud reunion).
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and other ARI WRs see full target share vs DET; reverse any prior MHJ fade beneficiaries.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) listed OUT for Eagles vs JAX in London, alongside DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Hollywood Brown.
items.why: Final injury report; missed practice all week.
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR corps gutted; heavy reliance on remaining RBs and Goedert (IN).
items.opportunity: Will Shipley/Dameon Pierce/Carson Steele committee; Dallas Goedert target bump.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) OUT for Ravens at ATL.
items.implication: Ravens offense without dual-threat QB; Zay Flowers Q, Likely elevated.
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely and remaining pass-catchers; backup QB stream.

items.text: Jayden Daniels and Chris Olave listed IN (Daniels full practice/elbow clear; Olave expected).
items.why: Final report confirmation after prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Commanders and Saints offenses normalized; reverse any backup beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for both; Daniels dual-threat back.

items.text: Breece Hall, Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman, Pat Bryant all OUT.
items.implication: Jets/Commanders/Chargers/Colts/others depth charts shift; handcuffs and WR2s elevated.
items.opportunity: Breece handcuff (Braelon Allen-type); Diggs absence boosts other WAS targets; Johnston out opens LAC WR; Pittman out for IND; Bryant IR short-term.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins both QUESTIONABLE (Chase concussion protocol; Higgins groin/neck); messy list overall.
items.why: Final report; Levitan braces for messy Sunday morning.
items.implication: If out, Gesicki/Meyers etc. surge; Chase Brown already loved.
items.opportunity: Backup WR/TE targets and Brown receiving work.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance); ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger/better role expected after Week 4 criticism, despite downside risk of reduced snaps.
items.why: Off final report; coach notes maintenance but full-go comments; media/fan pressure on usage.
items.implication: RB2 upside vs DET if full workload; monitor for snap-count caution.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries/routes/red-zone over Allgeier; 65%+ rush share potential.
items.conflict: Some analysts sit due to ankle comments and prior low usage vibes.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) on volume/matchup/coverage edges.
items.implication: Strong flex/TE starts; Wilson especially post-MHJ news.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone for Wilson (further boosted by MHJ inactive); Watson deep; Likely with Lamar out.

items.text: Dallas Goedert listed IN amid Eagles skill injuries.
items.implication: TE1 with Barkley/Smith out; target vacuum filler.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk for Malik Nabers long-term (knee becomes issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB, boomer coaching from Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) plus recent frustration over low second-half targets; knee kept him out of practice earlier.
items.implication: Monitor closely; short-term playable but ROS caution.
items.opportunity: Still high route/target share when healthy.
items.conflict: Elite talent overrides near-term for most.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume/red-zone hog vs soft Titans secondary.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 (pushes 'Brown Gobbler' nickname); workload + Bengals injury cascade + soft matchup.
items.why: Target-gobbling RB + potential Chase/Higgins absence boost + MIA defense.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) and Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17) due to tough matchups, thin roles, usage numbers, and Addison injury wrinkle.
